title: SARS-CoV2 Genome Sequencing Protocol Using Nanopore Rapid Kit
author: Nikki Freed
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bwyppfvn
materials: Pool all barcoded samples, noting the total volume.
Start the sequencing run using MinKNOW.

steps.title: Prepare cDNA from Viral RNA
steps.instruction: Prepare cDNA using the LunaScript RT SuperMix Kit in 0.2mL 8-strip tubes on ice.

substeps.instruction: Mix 2 µL LunaScript RT SuperMix Kit (5x) and 8 µL Template RNA (Total 10 µL).
Adjust RNA input based on Ct value: if Ct 12-15, dilute 100-fold in water; if Ct 15-18, dilute 10-fold in water; if Ct 18-35, use as is.
Include a negative control (e.g., water).
Prepare mastermix in a mastermix cabinet and aliquot into PCR strip tubes, wiping tubes when entering and leaving the cabinet.
Gently mix by pipetting and pulse spin the tube.

steps.title: Incubate cDNA Reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction in a PCR machine using the following thermal profile:

substeps.instruction: Hold at 4 °C

steps.title: Prepare Primer Pool Stocks
steps.instruction: If primers were ordered individually, generate 100µM primer pool stocks in a UV-sterilized mastermix cabinet.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 µL of each primer from Pool 1 to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube labeled 'Pool 1 (100µM)'.
Add 5 µL of each primer from Pool 2 to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube labeled 'Pool 2 (100µM)'.

steps.title: Dilute Primer Pools
steps.instruction: Dilute the 100µM primer pools to 10µM using molecular grade water.

substeps.instruction: Perform a 1:10 dilution of each pool.
Create multiple aliquots to prevent degradation or contamination.

steps.title: Set Up Multiplex PCR Reactions
steps.instruction: Prepare two separate PCR reactions (Pool 1 and Pool 2) for each sample in 0.2mL 8-strip PCR tubes within the mastermix hood.

substeps.instruction: For Pool 1 reaction: Mix 12.5 µL Q5 Hot Start HF 2x Master Mix, 1.1 µL Primer Pool 1 (10µM), and 8.9 µL Nuclease-free water (Total 22.5 µL).
For Pool 2 reaction: Mix 12.5 µL Q5 Hot Start HF 2x Master Mix, 1.1 µL Primer Pool 2 (10µM), and 9.0 µL Nuclease-free water (Total 22.5 µL).
Prepare as a mastermix in the cabinet and aliquot into labeled tubes, wiping tubes when entering and leaving.

steps.title: Add cDNA to PCR Reactions
steps.instruction: Add cDNA to the prepared PCR pools in the extraction and sample addition cabinet (UV sterilized).

substeps.instruction: Add 2.5 µL of cDNA sample to the 22.5 µL Pool 1 reaction and mix well by pipetting.
Add 2.5 µL of cDNA sample to the 22.5 µL Pool 2 reaction and mix well by pipetting.
Pulse centrifuge the tubes to collect contents at the bottom.

steps.title: Run Multiplex PCR
steps.instruction: Run the thermal cycler with the following program (typically 32 cycles, but range 25-35 based on Ct):

substeps.instruction: Heat Activation: 98 °C for 00:00:30 (1 cycle)
Denaturation: 98 °C for 00:00:15 (25-35 cycles)
Annealing and Extension: 65 °C for 00:05:00 (25-35 cycles)
Hold: 4 °C (Indefinite)

steps.title: Combine PCR Pools
steps.instruction: Combine the two amplified pools in a designated post-PCR workspace.

substeps.instruction: In a labeled 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, combine 10 µL of Pool 1 PCR reaction and 10 µL of Pool 2 PCR reaction (Total 20 µL).

steps.title: Quantify and Normalize DNA
steps.instruction: Quantify the pooled DNA using a Qubit fluorometer and adjust the concentration.

substeps.instruction: Adjust the DNA amount to 100 ng total per sample in 7.5 µL molecular grade water (e.g., if 100ng/ul, add 1ul DNA to 6.5ul water).
If DNA is under 100ng or concentration is unknown, use the full 7.5 µL of the pooled PCR reaction.
Use the full 7.5 µL for negative controls regardless of detectable DNA.

steps.title: Fragment DNA
steps.instruction: Fragment the normalized DNA in labeled 0.2 mL PCR tubes.

substeps.instruction: Mix 7.5 µL of diluted PCR reaction (100ng total) with 2.5 µL Fragmentation Mix RB01-12 (Total 10 µL).
Mix gently by flicking and spin down.
Incubate in a PCR machine: 30 °C for 00:01:00, 80 °C for 00:01:00, and 4 °C for 00:00:30.

steps.title: Clean Up Amplicons
steps.instruction: Perform Ampure XP Bead Cleanup using a 1:1 ratio of sample to beads.

steps.title: Barcode DNA
steps.instruction: Apply barcodes to the cleaned DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL of RAP (from RBK004 kit) to 10 µL of cleaned, barcoded DNA.
Mix gently by flicking and spin down.
Incubate for 00:05:00 at room temperature.

steps.title: Load and Sequence
steps.instruction: Load the prepared library into a MinION flow cell following the Oxford Nanopore Rapid Barcoding (RBK004) protocol.

substeps.instruction: Store library on ice until loading.
Sequence until approximately 10,000 to 20,000 reads (10-20Mb) per sample are captured.
